title: Godot Editor stopped with exit code: 3221226356
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproduce in: Godot_v4.4.1-stable_win64, Godot_v4.4.1-stable_mono_win64
- Tested Work Fine in: Godot_v4.4.1-stable_steam, Godot_v4.3-stable_mono_win64, Godot_v4.3-stable_win64

### System information

Window10, NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3070(Driver: 573.83)

### Issue description

**Godot Version**
Godot 4.4.1 and Godot 4.4.1 .Net

**Question**
Editor download from https://godotengine.org/download/windows/ is not running.(Click the .exe and nothing happen)
I try command start, get this error code:
Godot Editor stopped with exit code: 3221226356

I tried to run it with --verbose option and get this log file:

WorkerThreadPool: 32 threads, 9 max low-priority.
Godot Engine v4.4.1.stable.mono.official.49a5bc7b6 - https://godotengine.org
TextServer: Added interface "Dummy"
TextServer: Added interface "ICU / HarfBuzz / Graphite (Built-in)"
Native OpenGL API detected: 3.3: NVIDIA - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3070
NVAPI: Init OK!
NVAPI: Disabled OpenGL threaded optimization successfully
NVAPI: Disabled G-SYNC for windowed mode successfully

Godot 4.3 stable work fine for both standerd and mono version.
Moreover it is running correctly if I download 4.4.1 Stable from Steam. It is a really weired problem.

### Steps to reproduce

Just download latest Editor from https://godotengine.org/download/windows/  and run
